verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Canny serves an llms.txt at developers.canny.io (HTTP 200, titled 'Canny Developer Documentation'), so agents can be pointed at it. Its depth is unproven: only a truncated header is visible, no first-party docs describe it, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path. missing for 10: confirmation of full llms.txt contents and scope (e.g., API reference coverage), first-party documentation of agent-oriented docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.canny.io/llms.txt # Canny Developer Documentation
